why-choose-us: Choose a topic. Follow your own pace.
description: Discover the opportunities of E-learning platform, your ultimate destination for programming and web development education. Unleash your coding potential with professional instructors, interactive lessons, and a supportive community. Start your journey today!
label: ABOUT THE PLATFORM
title: A clear place to start learning.
intro: The learning platform brings programming courses and lesson outlines into one simple catalog. Explore a topic, see what a course covers, and choose where to begin.
observe-description: Search the catalog or browse programming topics to find a course that interests you.
interact-description: Open a course to see its lesson sequence and move between lesson previews.
understand-description: Browse freely in English or Russian, with a black or white interface and no account required.
demo-title: The course catalog is ready to explore.
demo-description: Explore the course catalog, create a learner account, and study the complete JavaScript Fundamentals course with examples, exercises, and a final project. Other courses contain sample outlines. Saved learning progress is still being developed.
